dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Thank you for your gift... it is most wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: But please, do not come here again.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Are you the... spring fairy?

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Yes... that's me.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: But I must apologize. I don't have the power to grant wishes, or anything of that nature. Sorry to disappoint.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: The most I can do is turn water into wine, make all drinks taste delicious, do a little bit of healing... that sort of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Also... I do apologize that for now I can only talk to you from within the water.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Tell me about Old Finch.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Oh... Finch has grown old, has he...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: When I first arrived here from Fontaine, he was still a little crybaby.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: But as his teardrops mingled with the spring water, I sensed his good and gentle nature.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: He was the first friend I made in Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Why won't you see him anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: My kind lives long lives... very long lives...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: But not so for humans...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: If there must be a painful parting, better that it happen earlier, to avoid the deep lake of grief... better that it be but a droplet, whisked away by the surging river of time, then lost in the vast ocean of memory...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Forgive me... I just couldn't face it, I... I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: Farewell! Though I do love talking to you, I must ask that you please do not come here again...

dialogues.speaker: Gentle Voice
dialogues.text: And as for Finch... I have no right to ask this of you, but please encourage him to leave this place also.
